lines.zh: 我沿着长廊走，袍角扫地。
lines.en: I walk the long hall, robe trailing.

lines.zh: 袍角扫过地面，没有声音。
lines.en: My robe hem sweeps the floor without a sound.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有淡淡的光。
lines.en: A faint light follows where I walk.

lines.zh: 我在柱子的阴影里停了一下。
lines.en: I pause in a pillar's shadow.

lines.zh: 从那里能看见整条走廊。
lines.en: From there I can see the whole hall.
I raise a hand and make a sign.

lines.zh: 袍子下面拖着一串符文。
lines.en: A line of runes drags from my hem.
I stand with my hands folded in my sleeves.
It is empty in a good way.
My doubles still stand in the corner.

lines.zh: 我抬手在那条裂纹上按了按。
lines.en: I press a hand to that crack.

lines.zh: 我的墙不喜欢留下痕迹。
幻术师的门口，没有退路。
lines.en: Past the illusioner's door there's no way back.

lines.zh: 我不在门口，也不在窗边。
lines.en: I am not at the door, nor at the window.
You turn, and only then am I there.
I raise a hand: do not hurry.

lines.zh: 我的声音从四个方向来。
lines.en: My voice comes from four directions.
You struck the third of me.
This is as it should be.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我在你后面。
lines.en: When you look at me, I am behind you.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我又在前面。
lines.en: When you turn, I am in front again.
I am struck and scatter into smoke.
I stand a few paces off.
You cannot tell where I was.
The pain is real. I have noted it.
It still tingles beneath my ribs.
I wait for it to close.
I drink only the water in shadows.
You hold it up. I do not look.
I have sat here a long while.

lines.zh: 分身还没散，你别急着数。
lines.en: My doubles haven't faded; don't count too soon.
Put it on the table if you like.
But I do not mean to change.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，可我只是影子。
lines.en: You strike me, but I am only a shadow.
The real I am on your left.
Now I am on the right.
The me you see isn't here.
I raise a hand and touch your shoulder.
My hand withdraws into my sleeve.
The phantoms faded at the right moment.

lines.zh: 它悬着，因为我说它该悬着。
lines.en: It floats because I say it floats.
This is a phantom. I leave it.
There is no mark of mine on this.
I never keep what belongs to others.
Three more arrows hide in my sleeve.
I raise a hand and every lamp dies.
You feel for direction in the dark.

lines.zh: 幻影站在你身后的角落。
lines.en: An illusion waits in the corner behind you.

lines.zh: 你听见我的声音在正前方。
lines.en: You hear my voice straight ahead.
I sit in my chair as before.
You turn, and the illusions close in.

lines.zh: 我一直没有离开这间屋子。
lines.en: I have never left this room.

lines.zh: 你跑了一圈，又回到原地。
lines.en: You run a circle and end where you began.
That door opens only in illusion.

lines.zh: 你看它的时候，它离得远。
lines.en: When you look at it, it is far.
You walk to it, and it is further.
I sit in my chair and watch.
I only make the way long.
I offer you a cup of water.
I place it before your feet.
The water in it will not spill.

lines.zh: 我抬手，四道幻影同时出现。
lines.en: I raise a hand and four phantoms appear.
I am inside one of them.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，走出去的是影子。
lines.en: I stay; it is my shadow that walks out.
I raise a hand and one lights.
These hands have woven too many illusions.
I get up from my chair.
The room is smaller than I remember.
There are new cracks in the wall.
And wait for him to enter.

lines.zh: 我从来不需要起身迎接。
他们会自己走到我面前。
lines.en: They come to me on their own.

lines.zh: 火烧掉我的一半幻影，真身退开了。
lines.en: Fire burns away half my phantoms; the true one steps back.

lines.zh: 我从梁上落下，落地时变成三个。
lines.en: I fall from the beam and land as three.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，屋子开始化开。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and the room begins to dissolve.

lines.zh: 炸响之后，屋里只剩下烟。
lines.en: After the blast only smoke is left in the room.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，我却没散。
lines.en: An arrow passes through me and I do not scatter.

lines.zh: 另一种术法压住我的幻影，只剩一个我。
lines.en: Another magic pins my phantoms; only one of me remains.

lines.zh: 太久没有访客，我的形在变薄。
lines.en: Too long without visitors; my shape thins.

lines.zh: 雷落进屋，所有幻影一起亮了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the room and every phantom flares.

lines.zh: 屋子散成黑，我也散开了。
lines.en: The room scatters into black, and so do I.
